response.rationale: Reach z-score of 6.5 is a large, flagged deviation well beyond noise thresholds. Own-action confound flag is false and OSA z-score is 0.0, so this is not the harness's own prior bid/budget move landing in the data. CPM is essentially flat (z = -0.47), which argues against a price/competition shock and is consistent with a genuine demand-side surge (more available volume at stable pricing). Classify as a real demand surge worth reacting to; magnitude ~6.5 baseline SDs with high confidence.
